lines: A package root carries code, so the package is imported as a whole:
@fullcalendar/core: 169,857 B in 81 modules on the dutyroster-main page, of which its root index.js is 50,585 B.
Importing the single module that is used instead of the package root lets the bundler drop the rest of the barrel.
core-js, 25,727 B on the dutyroster-main page: polyfills for browsers older than the build targets.
838,601 B in 3 pieces of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No module is delivered twice inside one page.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
